sewer_rat.base: Native64 angular blue-grey rat; dark navy outline, flat palette; collar and pink bare tail stay readable.

attack.observation: 0-6 jaw and tail prepare; 8 gives the clear wide-jaw bite; 9-13 recoil; 16 returns to the source pose. Frame7 rejected because it adds a disconnected white projectile.

contactPoint.description: Leading upper tooth / open bite mouth; selected index7 is raw frame8.

stun.observation: Dedicated chin-near-ground pose with buckled forelegs and limp tail. All nine frames hold the weak posture with a small tremble; no upright idle.

sewer_rat.crossReview: outskirts_art accepted visual style and agreed to reject attack source frame7; replacement stun inspected by residential_art.
sewer_rat.paletteCorrection: All selected frames mapped through PixelLab reduce_colors to the unchanged base sprite palette, dithering none; binary alpha and pixel positions preserved.

drowned_resident.base: Native64 empty-faced water echo; teal coat and brown door plank; no corpse or gore. Foundational story keeps real residents asleep.

attack.observation: 0-7 draw the same plank up/right with both hands;8 is the clear diagonal down-left strike;9-16 recover while boots retain the same ground line. Torso turns naturally in the windup but never flips attack direction.

contactPoint.description: Broken door-plank tip at the end of the diagonal down-left strike.

stun.observation: Rejected first idle-like stun. New forward-bowed head and dropped arms preserve both hands/one plank. All nine frames show the limp pose with a restrained shoulder tremble.

drowned_resident.crossReview: outskirts_art accepted shared style and the plank attack contact at8; both agents rejected original idle-like stun.
drowned_resident.paletteCorrection: All selected frames mapped through PixelLab reduce_colors to the unchanged base sprite palette, dithering none; binary alpha and pixel positions preserved.

water_wraith.base: Native64 angular watery hood, three lower tendrils, brass chest lantern. Same flat teal palette and dark outline.

attack.observation: 0-6 claws draw in;7-10 sharp left claw extension and trailing fluid body;11-16 retract to the original three-tendril hover. Lantern remains attached and no new legs or weapon appear.

contactPoint.description: Leading upper claw fingertip; lower claw reaches x22,y43 in the same frame.

stun.observation: Rejected original idle-like hover. Dedicated bowed hood, hanging arms and sagging tendrils maintain a visibly exhausted silhouette across all nine frames.

water_wraith.crossReview: outskirts_art accepted shared style and extension/recovery; both agents rejected original idle-like stun.
water_wraith.paletteCorrection: All selected frames mapped through PixelLab reduce_colors to the unchanged base sprite palette, dithering none; binary alpha and pixel positions preserved.
